tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos skyong rgyal po chen po'i gtor 'bul rje tshar pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// chos skyong rgyal po chen po dpe ha ra la gtor ma dbul bar 'dod pas/ gtor ma tshul bzhin bsham/ rang u rgyan du gsal bas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhed dgu thams cad 'byung ba stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gnas rnams nas chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po sku lnga/ yum chen/ las mkhan/ sprul pa yang sprul lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzhes shing 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i slad du badzra sa mā dzaḥ ces pas spyan drangs/ mahā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes pa lan lnga la sogs pa brjod pas/ gtor ma sman phud dang bcas pa bzhes shing dgyes par bsam la/ ho/ sngon tshe padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bka' dang dam la btags pa yi/ /chos skyong rgyal po mthu bo che/ /khyod la mchod cing bstod pa yis/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams bu nor dang / /'khor 'bangs longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ de ltar zhal gyis bzhes shing dgyes pas rang gnas su byon par bsam/ 'bad dang rtsol ba zhes sogs brjod do/ /zhes pa 'di rje btsun rdo rje 'chang tshar pas thon du mdzad pa'o// //bkra shis// ༈ hūm̐/ ka tsa dregs pa bandhe khros pa'i gzugs/ /khwa ta'i gdong can thang zhu chen po gyon/ /ga shal mgo rlon dar nag lhab lhub can/ /nga ro 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs rgod la bstod/ /ca po dkon nor kun gyi rjes su 'brang / /cha lugs ma nges cho 'phrul cir yang ston/ /ja chang sha khrag kun la 'dod dgur spyod/

/nya rgyas zla ba'i 'od ldan khyod la bstod/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /tha mal bandhe spre'u sogs su ston/ /da lta nyid du stong gsum yud kyis nyul/ /na tsha smyo 'bog ltas ngan 'bebs la bstod/ /pa la sha ltar 'jam pas rang sde skyong / /pha rol dgra bo'i steng du thog ltar drag /ba lang nor phyugs phyi nang dkor rdzas tshogs/ /ma lus skyong ba'i dkor srung khyod la bstod/ /tsa ra drag po'i las byed gza' gdong dang / /tsha grang nad gtong ma mo bye bas bskor/ /dza lang rgyas pa'i gdug can dgra bo'i tshogs/ /wa ltar zhum zhing brlag par byed la bstod/ /zhwa ltar skye bo yongs kyi gtsug na mtho/ /za byed lha srin yongs kyi sna 'dren cing / /'a 'ur 'jigs pa'i nga ros stong gsum g.yo/ /ya mtshan yid la 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /ra ba khang bzang gtsug lag dgon gnas 'di/ /la ba hrul po ji bzhin gyur pa la/ /sha tsha dad pa'i sems kyis gso bgyid na/ /sa bdag dregs pa khyod kyis snang ba stsol/ /ha hi dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar bzhad bzhin du/ /a la la yi zlos gar dang 'grogs pa'i/ /phun tshogs 'phrin las dge ba'i bkra shis kyis/ /sbyin po 'a zha'i mi dbang 'khor bcas skyongs/ /padma thod 'phreng 'byung gnas rdo rje dang / /byang phyogs dang rwa'i grub dbang mched rnams dang / /rgyal bzang en shrī'i brgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin du sgrub par mdzod// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ chos skyong rgyal po chen po'i gtor 'bul rje tshar pas mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
